name: DEFAULT_FORT
description: The default start fort (start-year / OP1, reset_fort.sh's default) rebuilt from a seed: fort_start_snapshot's world (PINNED POCKET, seed 12345) and its embark site, world tile (4,5), local rectangle (8,8) 4x4, with the standard 'Play now!' 7-dwarf embark. The site is pinned, so there is no search and no warning is rejected; the probe checks only the 7 citizens. docs/SEED-FORTS.md §6.
